method: 32-frame mean. Within each CFA phase remove Gaussian sigma15 (30 physical pixels) local background. Compare fixed high-frequency RMS and relative residual after black subtraction. Subtract mean temporal variance /32 from mean residual variance as a finite-sample approximation. Exclude margins, low signal, clipping and strong local gradients. Aggregate/correlation ROI is y=48..895, x=80..1007: preview shows a cable/scene boundary below. Full-row profiles are retained but the lower rows are not a flat standard.
